timeline.tweet: Is that anxiety I see from Djokovic??? Wait I think I am the anxious one... Oh my Wimbledon soul this game gets more exciting by the serve #Wimbledon #WimbledonFinal #Wimbledon18
Please get me out of this comatose state I find myself in... I am dying outchea

I was clinically diagnosed with depression at the age of 13. And I had been struggling ever since. Easter and Christmas were always hard for me because they represented family time. So I completely get how difficult this time may be for a lot of people...

I drink! Then sleep it off. It tends to remedy itself 😂😂😂 I have chronic gastritis which throws everything off in my body. I gave up figuring it out. I go about my life unless if something completely new then I google. *hides*

In essence, you're welcoming that negative energy, with open arms. Anxiety is worrying about future events... try to stay in the moment each day, relish the present. There are countless scenarios that could play out each day, its how you choose to look at them.
